annotations.title: Check an inbox's DNS and discovery

description: For a business's own AI: whether agents are led from its website and DNS to its agent inbox, and whether the inbox answers at inbox.<domain> (or host). Every item not in place comes with the exact record, line or file to add (fix_lines). ready needs one of four pointers on the website: /.well-known/agent-inbox.json, a line in llms.txt, <link rel="agent-inbox">, or a schema.org potentialAction.

domain.description: The business's own domain, like salon.example (a URL is read as its domain).

host.description: Where the inbox answers, when not inbox.<domain>: the domain itself or a name under it.

target.description: The CNAME target the host must point to, when known (a hosted inbox's Connect page shows it).

name: check_dns

outputSchema.description: Every field is described in this tool's outputSchema at https://network.surfingdog.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.

title: Check an inbox's DNS and discovery
